headline: NFL Week 6 TNF: Broncos visit Seahawks at Lumen Field
whyCareReason: Week 6 opens on Thursday Night Football under Seattle lights. Seahawks are 4-1; Broncos sit 2-3 looking to stay in AFC West contention.
teaser: Amazon Prime Video broadcasts Thursday at 8:15 p.m. ET. Bills beat Rams 37-34 in OT to close Week 5. Vikings and 49ers stand 5-0.
story: Week 6 of the 2026 NFL season begins Thursday 15 October at Lumen Field in Seattle. The Seattle Seahawks host the Denver Broncos on Amazon Prime Video and NFL+ at 8:15 p.m. ET (5:15 p.m. PT). Seattle enter at 4-1 after opening victories against the Patriots, Cardinals, and Chargers. Denver stand 2-3 after tough losses to the Chiefs and 49ers. Week 5 concluded with Tyler Bass drilling a 45-yard overtime field goal to lift Buffalo over the Rams 37-34 at SoFi Stadium. Unbeaten records belong to the Minnesota Vikings (5-0), San Francisco 49ers (5-0), and Kansas City Chiefs (4-0).
stakes: Seattle can push their record to 5-1 and keep pressure on the 49ers in the NFC West. Denver need a road win to reach 3-3.
rivalryAngle: A classic former AFC West rivalry renewed under the Lumen Field roar on Thursday night.
funFacts: Kickoff: Thursday 15 October 2026, 8:15 p.m. ET, Prime Video, Lumen Field, Seattle.
Records: Seahawks 4-1, Broncos 2-3. Unbeaten teams: Vikings 5-0, 49ers 5-0, Chiefs 4-0.
Week 5 MNF closed with Bills 37, Rams 34 in OT. Ravens beat Falcons 30-23 in OT on Sunday night.

keyPlayers.name: Bo Nix
keyPlayers.hook: Looking to guide Denver to 3-3 against a fierce Seattle pass rush.

keyPlayers.name: Kenneth Walker III
